notes:
Default v3.1.394 improves native process evidence: fatal tracebacks reach both
logs and recordings on supported local filesystems. Ordinary lifecycle events
remain nonduplicated, with the mirror status and both paths recorded at startup.
Unavailable hard links retain the primary fatal dump and ordinary mirrors;
unwritable logging remains nonblocking. The compiled release self-check verifies
direct native traceback capture.

280 source tests, seven project checks, GUI layout and smoke checks pass.
Firmware354, calibration and control settings are unchanged. The universal lock
remains disabled for testing. This improves crash capture; it does not claim to
identify or resolve the historical October18 access violation.
